rows.grounds: first member of compound with lopāt, indicating totality of what is lacking
ablative expressing cause or condition due to absence
optative expressing what is commendable under the stated condition
indicates limited duration or means; analyzed as given in compound relation with nirmitotsavaḥ
compound denoting a festival that has been carried out

items.question: What kind of festival remains commendable when all resources have been lost?
premises: Adverse circumstances can result in the loss of all resources or full observances.
A festival may still be performed with limited time or means.
A reduced observance can retain ritual value under constraint.
items.inference: Therefore, when complete observance is impossible, a festival performed on a modest scale is praiseworthy.
uncertainties: The exact morphological analysis of alpāhai is uncertain as given in the fused form.
items.plain_english: When everything is lacking, a festival performed in a short time is still praiseworthy.
